text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- The leader of the Croatian Peasant's Party (HSS) Zlatko Tomcic: HSS is heading an inefficient opposition bloc.
- Croatian post and telegraph (HPT), Pliva and Tobbaco Production Plant Rovinj have had the biggest profit in 1995.
- Croatia to join the Council of Europe on November 6.
- The House of Representatives debate: Are there going to be other scandals after the "wheat" scandal?
- Joint navy drill of the USS Klakring and Croatian navy gunboat Kralj Petar Kresimir IV in Dubrovnik

- Talks between deputy foreign minister Ivan Simonovic and an official of the Italian foreign ministry Piero Fassini: Croatia to soon sign a number of economic agreements with Italy. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
